faction_rules.name: Martial Ka’tah
faction_rules.description:
The Adeptus Custodes have developed many thousands of martial ka’tahs. Custodians are proficient in many of these arts, shifting stances according to the battlefield situation.
At the start of your Command phase, friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES units with this ability are readied. While a friendly unit is readied, you can select one of the ka’tah abilities presented below for that unit to use. If you do, that unit is no longer readied.
Each ka’tah ability will tell you when that ka’tah ability can be used, and the effects that ka’tah ability has on the unit using it.
We recommend placing a token next to each readied unit, removing it when that unit is no longer readied.
Favoured Ka’tah
Many of the most prominent shield hosts favour a specific martial ka’tah above all others.
All detachments tagged ‘Unique: Shield Host’ state a Favoured Ka’tah. If you selected one of these detachments, the ka’tah ability that is the Favoured Ka’tah of that detachment grants the additional effect listed in that detachment.
Example: If you selected the Solar Watch detachment, when you select the Calistus ka’tah ability for a readied unit, that unit has +2" M in addition to the normal effect of Calistus.
CONSERVAI
KA’TAH ABILITY
WHEN: Your Command phase.
TARGET: One friendly readied unit.
EFFECT: Until the end of the turn:
Being engaged/battle-shocked does not prevent your unit from being eligible to start an action.
Starting an action does not prevent your unit from being eligible to shoot.
CALISTUS
KA’TAH ABILITY
WHEN: Your Movement phase, when a friendly readied unit is selected to move.
TARGET: That readied unit.
EFFECT: When your unit makes a normal/advance/fall-back move, your unit can move through all types of model.
SALVUS
KA’TAH ABILITY
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly readied unit is selected to shoot.
TARGET: That readied unit.
EFFECT: Your unit can ignore modifiers to your unit’s:
BS.
Hit rolls and wound rolls.
DACATARAI
KA’TAH ABILITY
WHEN: Start of the Fight phase.
TARGET: One friendly readied unit.
EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks that target an enemy unit (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE units) can re-roll hit rolls of 1.
KAPTARIS
KA’TAH ABILITY
WHEN: Start of the Fight phase.
TARGET: One friendly readied unit.
EFFECT: Melee attacks that target your unit have -1 to hit rolls.
RENDAX
KA’TAH ABILITY
WHEN: Fight phase, when a friendly readied unit is selected to fight.
TARGET: One friendly readied unit.
EFFECT: Your unit’s melee attacks have [Lethal Hits: Monster/Vehicle].

faction_rules.name: Aegis of the Emperor
faction_rules.description:
The Adeptus Custodes are the shield of the Emperor: indomitable and nigh unbreakable.
Friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES units with this ability have Feel No Pain 5+ against mortal wounds.

faction_rules.name: Aquila Commander
faction_rules.description:
Shield-Captains who bear the title Aquila Commander have proven themselves true masters of battlefield tactics.
At the start of the battle round, if a model with this ability is your WARLORD, gain 1CP.

faction_rules.name: Daughters of the Abyss
faction_rules.description:
Bearers of the Pariah gene, Null Maidens are inured to psychic powers. Their Warp-smothering aura also provides limited protection for the Custodians at whose side they fight.
Friendly ANATHEMA PSYKANA units with this ability have Feel No Pain 3+ against psychic attacks.
Friendly ANATHEMA PSYKANA units with this ability have the following ability:
Psychic Null (Aura): Friendly ADEPTUS CUSTODES units within 6" of this unit have Feel No Pain 5+ against psychic attacks.
#### Anathema Psykana
Though the Adeptus Custodes often fight alongside the Silent Sisterhood, they take orders only from their own commanders, or from the Emperor Himself.
You can include ANATHEMA PSYKANA units in your army, even though they do not have the ADEPTUS CUSTODES faction keyword.
When mustering your army, unless otherwise stated:
You cannot select ANATHEMA PSYKANA as your army faction.
You cannot select an ANATHEMA PSYKANA model to be your WARLORD.

faction_rules.name: Special Move Types
faction_rules.description:
The following are special move types that certain or all of your units are eligible to make.
SHOCK DISEMBARK MOVE18.07
SET-UP DISTANCE: 3"
ELIGIBLE IF:
Embarked within a TRANSPORT on the battlefield
Did not embark within that TRANSPORT this phase
EFFECT: Set up as described in Set Up (03.02).
WHILE MOVING: Set up each model wholly within the set-up distance of that TRANSPORT.
AFTER MOVING: Your unit is not eligible to declare a charge until the end of the turn.
